title: Perforce VCS Driver Flow
interaction_flow: VcsRepository → PerforceDriver: getDriver() → new PerforceDriver(repoConfig, io, config, httpDownloader, process)
VcsRepository → PerforceDriver: driver->initialize()
PerforceDriver → PerforceDriver: initPerforce(repoConfig) → Perforce::create(repoConfig, url, repoDir, process, io)
PerforceDriver → Perforce: p4Login()
Perforce → Perforce: queryP4User() [checks p4User, calls getP4variable('P4USER')]
Perforce → ConsoleIO: io->ask('Enter P4 User:') [if no user found]
Perforce → Perforce: isLoggedIn() → generateP4Command(['login','-s'], false) → executeCommand()
Perforce → ConsoleIO: io->askAndHideAnswer('Enter password...') [if not logged in]
Perforce → ProcessExecutor: process->execute(['p4','-u',user,'-p',port,'login','-a'], password)
PerforceDriver → Perforce: checkStream() → generateP4Command(['depots'], false) → executeCommand() [sets p4DepotType]
PerforceDriver → Perforce: writeP4ClientSpec() → getP4ClientSpec() → fopen(spec,'w') → writeClientSpecToFile()
PerforceDriver → Perforce: connectClient() → generateP4Command(['client','-i']) → new Process(cmd, null, null, specContents) → process->run()
VcsRepository → PerforceDriver: driver->getRootIdentifier() → returns branch
VcsRepository → PerforceDriver: driver->hasComposerFile(rootIdentifier) → perforce->getComposerInformation('//' + depot + '/' + identifier)
PerforceDriver → Perforce: getComposerInformation(path) → getFileContent('composer.json', identifier)
Perforce → Perforce: getFilePath(file, identifier) → generateP4Command(['files', path], false) → executeCommand()
Perforce → ProcessExecutor: process->execute(['p4','-u',user,'-p',port,'print',path])
VcsRepository → PerforceDriver: driver->getTags() → perforce->getTags()
Perforce → ProcessExecutor: execute(['p4','-u',user,'-c',client,'-p',port,'labels']) [parses Label lines → returns map tag→stream@label]
VcsRepository → PerforceDriver: driver->getComposerInformation(identifier) [per tag]
VcsRepository → PerforceDriver: driver->getBranches() → perforce->getBranches()
Perforce → ProcessExecutor: execute(['p4','streams','//depot/...']) [if stream depot → list branches]
Perforce → ProcessExecutor: execute(['p4','changes', stream+'/...']) [get last change number → returns master→stream@changeNum]
VcsRepository → PerforceDriver: driver->getComposerInformation(identifier) [per branch]
VcsRepository → PerforceDriver: preProcess(driver, data, identifier) → driver->getDist(identifier) [returns null for Perforce]
VcsRepository → PerforceDriver: preProcess(driver, data, identifier) → driver->getSource(identifier) → returns {type:'perforce', url, reference, p4user}
VcsRepository → PerforceDriver: driver->cleanup() → perforce->cleanupClientSpec()
Perforce → Perforce: cleanupClientSpec() → generateP4Command(['client','-d',client], false) → executeCommand() → filesystem->remove(clientSpec)
key_relationships: VcsRepository instantiates PerforceDriver (via drivers map: 'perforce' => PerforceDriver::class)
Perforce depends_on ProcessExecutor (all p4 command execution)
static_check: Perforce::checkServerExists(url, processExecutor): bool — called by PerforceDriver::supports() to verify p4 server at URL responds with exit code 0
important_notes: PerforceDriver acts as a thin adapter; all p4 logic is in Perforce utility. VcsRepository drives the entire discovery loop (tags→branches). generateP4Command() assembles array-based commands with optional -c <client> flag. Client spec is a temp file at cache-vcs-dir/depot/<hostname>_<time>.p4.spec. Stream depot vs. classic depot distinction determined by checkStream() setting p4DepotType. getCommitLogs() resolves label references to change numbers via getChangeList() before calling 'p4 filelog'. ConsoleIO is only invoked when P4USER/P4PASSWD env vars are absent.
